plugins.waitingNext: It is switched on and waits for: {{seams}}. It starts by itself when one is available.
plugins.dependents: {{names}} need {{id}}: they require it, or it is the last provider of a seam they need. Switch them off together?
plugins.disabled: It is off and stays off after a restart. Switch it on again in Settings → Plugins.
plugins.failedNext: Nothing is running for it. Fix the error shown in Settings → Plugins, then switch it on again.
plugins.autoOffBody:
{{registration}} failed {{times}} times within 10 minutes. Last error: {{error}}
Switch it back on in Settings → Plugins once the cause is fixed.
plugins.jobCancelled: Cancelled: the plugin was switched off.
plugins.configured: The new settings are in use.
plugins.configuredOff: Saved. They are used when the plugin is switched on.
plugins.invalidSettings: Nothing was saved: some values are not valid.
plugins.settingsLater: Its settings appear once it has been switched on.
plugins.trialOn: Its hooks now run in trial: Reelix records what they would change and applies nothing.
plugins.toolsOn: Its typed tools are offered to the assistant from the next conversation.
plugins.toolsOff: Its typed tools are no longer offered; its operations stay reachable through the reelix tool.
plugins.orderSaved: The new order applies from the next decision.
plugins.approveFirst: It is installed but not approved: review what it declares and approve it in Settings → Plugins.
plugins.reapprove: Its files changed since you approved them, so it is not loaded. Review it again in Settings → Plugins.
plugins.restartButton: Saved. The code is loaded when Reelix restarts: use Restart in Settings → Plugins.
plugins.restartManual: Saved. The code is loaded when Reelix restarts: run `docker compose restart reelix`, or stop `reelix serve` and start it again.
plugins.incompatibleTitle: Plugin {{id}} cannot run on this Reelix
plugins.incompatibleBody: {{id}} is not loaded: {{why}}. Reelix is now {{version}}. Update the plugin, or uninstall it, in Settings → Plugins.
plugins.changedBody: The files of {{id}} are not what you approved, so it is not loaded. Review it in Settings → Plugins and approve it again if the change is yours.
plugins.uninstalledKept: Its code is removed. Its settings, secrets and stored data are kept and come back if you install it again.
plugins.uninstalledAll: Its code, settings, secrets and stored data are removed.
plugins.jobPromptOn: Its prompt sections now reach background jobs too, from the next job.
plugins.jobPromptOff: Its prompt sections no longer reach background jobs.
plugins.modelSet: Its model use is set: budget ${{usd}} a day, roles {{roles}}.
plugins.modelSetUnmetered: Its model use is set: no daily budget, roles {{roles}}.
plugins.budgetReached: {{id}} has used its model budget for today (${{usd}}); it resets at midnight. The owner can raise it on the plugin's page.
plugins.roleRefused: {{id}} may not use the model role "{{role}}"; the owner can allow it on the plugin's page.
plugins.cycle: Refused: the plugins it requires go round in a circle ({{cycle}}), so none of them can start first. Remove the requirement from one of them.
plugins.proposedBody: Proposed by {{by}}. Nothing is installed or run until you approve it: review what it declares, its files and the difference.
plugins.runtimeRefused: It cannot run in a process of its own: it has a raw pi extension or compiled dependencies.
plugins.processChoiceLost: You chose to run {{id}} in a process of its own, but this version cannot run there (it has a raw pi extension or compiled dependencies). It stays off until you choose to run it inside Reelix on its page.
plugins.runtimeProcess: It now runs in a process of its own, with only its context: Node keeps it from Reelix's files and from starting programs, and Reelix's code there keeps its network to Reelix's fetch. A hostile plugin may get past that second part (docs/plugins.md §11.7).
plugins.runtimeInProcess: It now runs inside Reelix, where its code can do anything Reelix can.
plugins.screenOff: {{id}} is not running; switch it on in Settings → Plugins to open its screen.
plugins.processEnded: Its process ended ({{error}}); it starts again in {{seconds}} s.

hooks.guardAlarmTitle: The plugin {{plugin}} is hiding nearly every release
hooks.guardAlarmBody: {{plugin}} hid {{hidden}} of {{total}} releases over its last {{calls}} searches. Check its settings, or switch it off under Settings → Plugins.

follow.filteredBody_one: {{count}} candidate was hidden by {{plugins}}. Open the release list and use "Show hidden", or change the plugin's settings.
follow.filteredBody_other: {{count}} candidates were hidden by {{plugins}}. Open the release list and use "Show hidden", or change the plugin's settings.

hiddenRelease.approvalBody: {{name}} is hidden by a plugin ({{why}}). Download it anyway?
